exposure: Strontium citrate (0 mg/kg, 680 mg/kg, 1360 mg/kg, 2267 mg/kg)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant female Sprague Dawley (SD) rats.
finding: High-dose strontium citrate (2267 mg/kg) caused statistical differences in anomalies of fetal bones and eyes, indicating an adverse effect on embryonic and fetal development in SD rats.
gest_age: Fetuses examined on 20th day of gestation
